usage: __main__.py [-h]
                   {bench,context,preview,costs,hf-check,llama-compare,quality}
                   ...

Clover measurement and reference tools; run from the repository root.

positional arguments:
  {bench,context,preview,costs,hf-check,llama-compare,quality}
  arguments

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Optional tool selectors after the command:
  bench: resources
  preview: split-kv, audit, graphs, lifecycle, verify, ab, outputs
  costs: abab
  hf-check: denoise, selfspec, quantization
  quality: fetch-data
Omit the selector to run the default tool. Each tool accepts --help.

usage: python -m benchmarks.clover bench [-h] --model MODEL --output OUTPUT
                                         [--modes MODES] [--prompts PROMPTS]
                                         [--long-prompts-json LONG_PROMPTS_JSON]
                                         [--tokens TOKENS] [--warmups WARMUPS]
                                         [--repeats REPEATS]
                                         [--cache-slots CACHE_SLOTS]
                                         [--memory-ratio MEMORY_RATIO]
                                         [--context-size CONTEXT_SIZE]
                                         [--accept-rule {exact,threshold}]
                                         [--reuse-prefix]
                                         [--runtime-breakdown]
                                         [--clover-max-width {0,8,16,32}]
                                         [--cache-auto] [--embedding-host]
                                         [--phase-cache-stats]
                                         [--no-penalties] [--require-exact]
                                         [--capture-first-logits]
                                         [--capture-logits-steps CAPTURE_LOGITS_STEPS]
                                         [--bf16-dense-baseline]

Recorded offline Clover mode comparison with fixed prompts and token arrivals.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL
  --output OUTPUT
  --modes MODES
  --prompts PROMPTS
  --long-prompts-json LONG_PROMPTS_JSON
                        Saved {"prompts": {name: {"user_text": ...}}}; select
                        names with --prompts
  --tokens TOKENS
  --warmups WARMUPS
  --repeats REPEATS
  --cache-slots CACHE_SLOTS
  --memory-ratio MEMORY_RATIO
  --context-size CONTEXT_SIZE
  --accept-rule {exact,threshold}
  --reuse-prefix        Diagnostic only; default benchmark recomputes the
                        complete prompt
  --runtime-breakdown   Separate instrumented run: CUDA event envelopes for
                        preview, verify, state and prompt/pending advance
  --clover-max-width {0,8,16,32}
  --cache-auto
  --embedding-host
  --phase-cache-stats   With --runtime-breakdown, snapshot GPU miss counters
                        at phase boundaries
  --no-penalties
  --require-exact
  --capture-first-logits
  --capture-logits-steps CAPTURE_LOGITS_STEPS
  --bf16-dense-baseline
                        Benchmark-only Qwen override: dequantize stored dense
                        linears to BF16 while keeping NVFP4 experts

usage: python -m benchmarks.clover costs [-h] --native NATIVE --hf HF --output
                                         OUTPUT

Conditional denoise throughput budgets from HF progress and native measured
costs. This is a fixed-hardware, fixed-prefix-distribution compute budget, not
a universal algorithmic upper bound. Native progress and controller efficiency
are reported separately; exceeding the HF-conditioned estimate is possible
when progress differs.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --native NATIVE
  --hf HF
  --output OUTPUT

                                            NATIVE_RESULTS --output OUTPUT
                                            [--tokens TOKENS]
                                            [--prompts PROMPTS]
                                            [--precision {nvfp4,bf16,fp8,gguf}]

Same-weight official forwards with independent exact-prefix acceptance.
Reference commits accepted inputs by causal replay because HF exposes only
final GDN states. The FreeToken implementation instead retains transactional
snapshots. Replay here is an oracle implementation detail, never a serving
benchmark.

usage: python -m benchmarks.clover hf-check [-h] --source SOURCE --checkpoint
                                            CHECKPOINT --prompts-json
                                            PROMPTS_JSON --output OUTPUT
                                            [--reference REFERENCE]
                                            --precision {bf16,nvfp4,fp8}
                                            [--steps STEPS]

Compare routed-weight recipes on an identical BF16-generated causal history.
Run BF16 first, then pass its output directory as --reference for NVFP4/FP8.
The bounded storage adapter calls the pinned official HF forward unchanged.
Both raw distributions and checkpoint-penalized decisions are reported; these
are distinct from the all-mask, first-block preview stress experiment.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source SOURCE
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
  --prompts-json PROMPTS_JSON
  --output OUTPUT
  --reference REFERENCE
  --precision {bf16,nvfp4,fp8}
  --steps STEPS

usage: python -m benchmarks.clover quality [-h] --source SOURCE --checkpoint
                                           CHECKPOINT --data DATA --output
                                           OUTPUT --backend {native,hf}
                                           [--precision {nvfp4,bf16,fp8,gguf}]
                                           [--tokens TOKENS] [--limit LIMIT]
                                           [--cache-slots CACHE_SLOTS]
                                           [--datasets DATASETS] [--resume]
                                           [--extend-from EXTEND_FROM]

Fixed first-50 GSM8K and HumanEval, identical greedy causal protocols. HF
precision choices change routed weights only; arithmetic is official Clover.
Results are exploratory subset scores, not a full benchmark quality claim.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source SOURCE
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
  --data DATA
  --output OUTPUT
  --backend {native,hf}
  --precision {nvfp4,bf16,fp8,gguf}
  --tokens TOKENS
  --limit LIMIT
  --cache-slots CACHE_SLOTS
  --datasets DATASETS
  --resume              Validate protocol and skip recorded cases
  --extend-from EXTEND_FROM
                        Larger token cap: reuse EOS-terminated cases, rerun
                        only capped cases

usage: python -m benchmarks.clover quality [-h] --output OUTPUT

Fetch only fixed-revision OpenAI evaluation datasets, never model files.

usage: python -m benchmarks.clover llama-compare [-h] --executable EXECUTABLE
                                                 --model MODEL --prompts-json
                                                 PROMPTS_JSON --output OUTPUT
                                                 [--frontend {server,cli}]
                                                 [--modes MODES]
                                                 [--prompts PROMPTS]
                                                 [--tokens TOKENS]
                                                 [--warmups WARMUPS]
                                                 [--repeats REPEATS]
                                                 [--cache-mib CACHE_MIB]
                                                 [--context-size CONTEXT_SIZE]
                                                 [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE]
                                                 [--ubatch-size UBATCH_SIZE]
                                                 [--load-mode {mmap,none}]

Measure an unmodified official Clover llama.cpp build with exact prompt ids.
Server trials retain the expert cache but disable prompt/KV reuse. CLI trials
start a fresh model process: their cache state is deliberately labelled cold.
Raw streams/logs and the built-in EOS-inclusive counters are always preserved.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --executable EXECUTABLE
  --model MODEL
  --prompts-json PROMPTS_JSON
  --output OUTPUT
  --frontend {server,cli}
  --modes MODES
  --prompts PROMPTS
  --tokens TOKENS
  --warmups WARMUPS
  --repeats REPEATS
  --cache-mib CACHE_MIB
  --context-size CONTEXT_SIZE
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
  --ubatch-size UBATCH_SIZE
  --load-mode {mmap,none}

usage: python -m benchmarks.clover preview [-h] --stage {native,reference}
                                           --model MODEL --source SOURCE
                                           [--native-output NATIVE_OUTPUT]
                                           --output OUTPUT

Paired preview arithmetic diagnostics; fixed weights, inputs and clean prefix.
No reference arithmetic in this file is a serving backend or a timing
benchmark. Dense/MoE oracle weights remain exactly dequantized FP32, avoiding
BF16 weight rounding.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --stage {native,reference}
  --model MODEL
  --source SOURCE
  --native-output NATIVE_OUTPUT
  --output OUTPUT
